description: "Captain John Smith" by Charles Dudley Warner is a historical account written during the late 19th century. The work aims to provide a thorough exploration of the life and adventures of Captain John Smith, a significant but often romanticized figure in early American history, particularly regarding his interactions with Indigenous people and his role in the founding of Jamestown, Virginia.
